sentences.text: The evidence shows that a UCB shall not levy pre-payment charges in several covered cases, including existing floating rate term loans sanctioned before December 31, 2025 for purposes other than business to individual borrowers, and certain loans sanctioned or renewed on or after January 1, 2026. [E11, E12, E14]
The evidence provided does not state any monetary penalty that RBI imposes for levying a prohibited foreclosure or pre-payment charge. [E11, E12, E14, E15, E16, E17, E18]

The searched rules address whether pre-payment charges are permitted and how they are to be calculated if levied, but they do not give a penalty amount for a breach in the materials provided. [E11, E12, E14, E15, E16, E17]

missing.slot: monetary penalty for levying prohibited foreclosure charges
missing.searched: Reviewed the in-force UCB Responsible Business Conduct Directions, 2025 paragraphs 260, 261(1), 261(2)(ii), 261(5), 261(7), and 261(8), plus the superseded pre-payment charge materials.
